extract: Alan Daniel Maman, known professionally as the Alchemist, is an American record producer, DJ and rapper. Critically acclaimed for his sample-heavy production style, he is regarded as one of the most influential producers in modern hip-hop and underground rap. His frequent collaborators include Mobb Deep, Larry June, Action Bronson, Freddie Gibbs, Roc Marciano, ScHoolboy Q, Griselda, Armand Hammer, Boldy James, Earl S
